not included in my 2012 Report.

(5) My Reed Smith capital account, listed in my 2011 Report on Line 31, was fully paid out in 2011. That is why it is not included in my 2012 Report.

in May 2012. Conoco shareholders received shares of Philip's 66.

reported at Lines 38 and 144 of the original 2012 Report (Lines 44 and 150 of this amended Report). Kraft changed its name to Mondelez in 2012 and that is why

the sale is listed as Mondelez shares.

(8) The Conneaut School District Bond reported in the 2011 Report on Line 55 was redeemed in 2012. Tt is reported in this amended report on Line 376. The
